sisi.depan: At the far end of the corridor is a massive hexagonal blast door sealed shut, with a glowing blue status panel to its side and a small, frosted observation window set high above.
sisi.kanan: The right wall features a rectangular sliding door leading to a side passage, a wall-mounted ventilation fan encrusted with frost, and a cluster of frozen conduits branching out from the floor.
sisi.belakang: Behind the camera, the corridor begins from a jagged metal archway, with a damaged wall section nearby revealing frozen inner circuitry.
sisi.kiri: Along the left wall runs a series of thick, ice-covered pipes, a recessed alcove holding a frozen maintenance console, and a single flickering blue strip light.

tengah: A low-profile automated sentry drone hovers silently in the middle distance facing forward, and patches of black ice slick the grated metal floor.
atas: The ceiling consists of a central spine of overhead cable trays coated in rime ice and several recessed hexagonal light panels that cast a cold blue glow.
